distinctAssayDerivation: 4 founders * 8 evolution seeds * 2 nonzero times * 2 normal-mutation draws * 16 technical assays, plus 4 founders * 16 identical-genome assays shared across time-zero and verified mutation-off observations. Biological missingness does not remove requested observations. Exact cache keys must include genomes, config, assay seeds and assignment.
limits: Uses 10,000-step capability throughput, not measured mutation-ledger or 20,000-step assay throughput.
Does not include ancestry metadata, readback, checkpoint I/O, analysis, thermal contention or interrupted units.
Both-extinct and absent samples remain unavailable observations; never discard them to improve estimates.
Requires pilot acceptance and a complete executable study/resource freeze before launch.
